what: The OwnExposure research question, its construct, its outcome, its controls, its falsifiers, its scope vocabulary and its GO/NARROW/STOP thresholds, frozen before any natural-play outcome was computed.
why: The mission's own words: a negative answer is a successful result if it is well measured. That is only true if what counts as negative was fixed first. Thresholds chosen after a number is seen are a description of the number.
ordering_rule: repository reconciliation -> construct located in the implementation -> freeze -> new compute -> analysis -> scope -> gate -> verdict
checked_by: GATE-RESEARCH-RECONCILED, on every `npm run gates`, via RESEARCH_RELATIONS in scripts/research-scan.ts

scripts/learning-v3/verify_freeze.py docs/system-invariant/FREEZE.json, which adds what a hash cannot: that one commit introduced both documents and touched nothing outside docs/system-invariant/, that no later commit modified them, and that the downstream analysis commit is a descendant of this one
what_this_does_not_establish: That the frozen question is the right question, or that OwnExposure is a real invariant. A hash proves order, not truth.
